title: Top Dog Beds for Big, Small & Senior Dogs (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Products were selected from Consumer Reports, CNET, Smart Bark, Business Insider, and Spots.com. The picks were ranked by the number of sources that mentioned them and by the features highlighted in those sources.
assumptions: Prices are not listed in the sources, so no price information is included.
